name: Brixy Content List Multiple
author: https://brixy.dev

sections.description:
Enhance your WordPress with the Brixy Content List Multiple for WordPress plugin. This tool integrates the Brixy App Builder API to show Brixy-built lists into WordPress Pages — whether in pages or directly in your template using the shortcodes like [brixy_content_list instance=”XXX”], where XXX is the Brixy plugin Instance.

Key Features:

  • Shows a list of all records in either a table or block view, with options to filter, sort by columns, toggle columns, and delete records.
  • Straightforward setup through a simple WordPress settings page.
  • Plugin can have multiple instances with unique settings. For example, one plugin instance might display information accessible to a specific user, while another shows content based on a different user’s permissions;
  • Each plugin instance can display a different list of records based on the specified Brixy List ID.

External Service Usage:

NOTE: Brixy Content List Multiple for WordPress plugin relies on external services provided by Brixy App Builder API. The plugin use API URL, API Token for connection with Brixy, and login credentials for a Brixy User.

To use this plugin, you must:

  1. Create some list in Brixy App Builder;
  2. Enable the API and generate an API Token in your Brixy installation;
  3. Enter API settings and Brixy user credentials;
  4. Input the Brixy List ID in the plugin’s settings;
  5. Display the list of records whether in pages or directly in your template use the shortcode like [brixy_content_list instance=”XXX”], where XXX is the Brixy plugin Instance;

Legal Compliance:

This plugin connects to the Brixy App Builder API, sending the necessary data to communicate with the platform and show list of records.
sections.installation:
Installing Brixy Content Add/Edit is straightforward, just follow the steps below.

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/brixy_list directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WordPress > Settings > Brixy Content List and configure the plugin.
